assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: pre-modeling architectural visualization for a Chinese industrial park carbon-management platform. Create one landscape 16:9 high-resolution image, a refined photorealistic architectural drone rendering at a 45-degree elevated oblique camera, realistic physically based materials, natural slightly warm late-morning sunlight, soft shadows, credible Henan plain terrain and distant low development. Contemporary existing Chinese industrial/campus architecture, restrained white/gray and muted green, detailed roofs, windows, lane markings, curb lines, trees, parked cars at correct scale. Buildings and internal roads are the visual focus. A continuous grounded landscape, no floating island, no cutaway slab, no tabletop model, no sci-fi, no cyan wireframe, no neon, no charts, no HUD, no labels, no lettering, no logos, no dramatic mountains, no invented solar panels. This is an aesthetic concept requiring approval, not survey-accurate site reconstruction. Subject: 绿色家居产业园区 (green home furnishing manufacturing district). Use the attached image solely as a visual reference for plausible industrial building typology and materials, not as a surveyed complete district layout. Show a broad established industrial district with multiple large low-rise white and silver sawtooth production halls, repeated long roof spans and skylight strips, compact administrative blocks, a modest processing plant and silos near one factory, delivery yards and tree-lined wide roads. View wide enough to read multiple distinct factory compounds and a green perimeter. Premium Blender Cycles architectural visualization, realistic operational industrial park, not a resort.
